visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a cartoon man sleeping in bed, his mouth wide open and uvula vibrating excessively while snoring. (2) The camera pulls back to reveal a cartoon woman lying next to him, her eyes wide with bloodshot veins and a look of deep fatigue and annoyance. (3) A series of black screens with white text introduce different comedic 'types' of responses to snoring. (4) The woman is shown attempting to 'mute' the man's snoring by interacting with a floating digital volume slider that appears on screen. (5) She then leaves the bedroom, carries her pillow into the living room, and collapses on the couch, though visual 'sound waves' indicate the snoring reaches her through the walls. (6) She returns to bed wearing oversized fluffy pink earmuffs, yet she still looks tormented. (7) In a final comedic attempt, she places a harmonica in the man's mouth, making his snoring sound like a melody. (8) The video transitions to a promotional segment where a cartoon male creator with glasses speaks directly to the camera with high energy. (9) Diagrams and animations show a man wearing a CPAP machine with airflow paths highlighted. (10) A woman presents custom earplug cases and smiles, followed by a final scene of the couple sleeping soundly and happily together.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous animated series of scenarios involving a loud snorer to build empathy with partners who suffer from sleep deprivation. It then transitions into an informative promotion for Hongyun's sleep testing services, CPAP machines, and custom earplugs, offering a discount code for viewers.
